L2의 올라간 신발 발끝은 수평 쪽, 코치 발끝은 위쪽으로 남아 조정 전 차이가 보임. 조수는 왼쪽에서 두 전신 촬영.
네 손/네 발의 귀속과 얼굴 식별 가능. 의자·포스터·monitor·문 및 복장 유지. 과장 자세의 웃음 읽힘. 원본/복사본 SHA256 일치.

images.prompt:
Create one newly rendered 16:9 cinematic first-frame image, not a collage or storyboard page. Use the supplied approved V8 reference to preserve exact casting, wardrobe, creature design, architecture, props and left-right continuity. Depict the start of future motion, not its payoff. No captions, subtitles, logos, watermark or random writing baked in; typography will be added in post. Preserve a calm high-contrast region for later captions without obscuring or shrinking essential action. No extra characters or giant decorative props. Wide ending. Two people retain the rigid floor poses in lower right; photographer ready for another photo. Left exit slightly open. Large unobstructed dark-teal upper-left wall for later typography. Preserve portrait and all costumes.
Reference1 supplies the wider ending composition and blank teal wall. New reference2 supplies precise CURRENT faces, matching body positions, props and continuity. New reference3 anchors gym. Render a NEW 16:9 single realistic cinematic full wide shot. Lower-right half contains burgundy female coach on near side and teal male trainee behind her, both lying on backs parallel, heads at right, feet at left. Both right arms raised diagonally toward screen-left; both right knees bent at90degrees, both left legs flat and left arms relaxed on mat. NOW both raised shoes match: ankle flexed, toe pointed upward-left, since trainee corrected the toe in preceding shot. Same dignified intense faces, coach bun/headband/whistle and burgundy piping, trainee curly hair and teal stripes. Gray-polo photographer kneels just left of their feet, holds camera aimed at both, about to take one MORE photograph. No extra living people; yellow trainee and blue-shirt P have departed. Preserve black chair pushed behind heads, black monitor/laptop cart at far right with P's low-seated aftermath. Huge upper-body P portrait hangs upper-right as in wide reference1. Left door is SLIGHTLY OPEN before slowly closing later; do not close it yet. Upper-left dark teal wall must be a large EMPTY quiet rectangle for later Q-AI Fair typography, but do not generate ANY typography now. Leave at least left 45 percent of upper half free of poster, faces, hands, lamps or decorative props. Same warm amber lighting and wood floor. Whole body limbs and mat visible, high detail, 16:9, no text, logos, symbols, watermark or UI.
images.next_motion: A가 한 장 더 찍고 T·L2는 자세를 유지한다. 왼쪽 문만 천천히 닫힌다. 카메라 고정.
images.camera_notes: 고정 와이드. 웃음의 인물은 하단 오른쪽, 좌상단은 후편집 자막용 빈 벽.

notes: 실제 새 PNG 열람. 두 인물의 등/오른팔/한 무릎/발끝 자세 일치, 조수는 다음 촬영 준비. 오른쪽 하단에 웃음의 전신 배치.
왼쪽 출입문은 열린 상태이며 좌상단 청록벽의 넓은 빈 면이 행사명/초대문구용으로 확보됨.
포스터와 monitor/의자/매트/복장 연속. 글자 없이 납품, 원본/복사본 SHA256 일치. 실제 문닫힘/셔터 등 동작 성공은 이번 정지이미지 검수 범위 밖.
